evidence: Implements the getscripthistory RPC in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp and refactors common transaction JSON formatting in src/rpc/rawtransaction_util.cpp.
rationale: Introduces getscripthistory to address a major programmatic gap that forced light-wallet servers and node operators into running external indexing databases. The query interface supports descriptors, raw scripts, and spending lookups, though reviewers noted resource accounting concerns on block reads.
